data.text: Luke, I won’t organize a scramble that destroys the lake my family taught me to fish. But Jack is right: promises checked after the catch come too late. Let’s leave our nets ashore until we settle this, then fish together with a shared tally and stop at 50 tons—10 each. That gives you the same share as every longtime local and leaves all five of us a living next month. Are you willing to pause and work with us? If not, what makes taking everything today worth giving up your future catch?
